goal: Output length review: limits on what the model may produce, and what happens when it reaches them.
use: Output length review: limits on what the model may produce, and what happens when it reaches them. Use when a feature asks a model for open-ended or long output.

steps.note: List the outputs. Each call, its expected length and who reads it.
Check the limit. Confirm a maximum output size is set.
Check the cut-off. Flag output that is cut mid-sentence or mid-structure without a sign.
Check the format. Structured output should be validated after it is produced.
Report. Each output with its limit, its failure when cut, and the fix.
